items.question: How much nuclear power capacity, in megawatts, is part of the UAE's electricity generation fleet?
items.fact: UAE generation fleet includes 5,560 MW nuclear power capacity

items.question: What share of the UAE's total installed electricity generation capacity is thermal generation, in per cent?
items.gold: Thermal generation accounts for about 74 per cent of installed capacity.
items.fact: Thermal generation is about 74 per cent of UAE installed capacity
